segments.title: 第14章 班級成績單
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Era Chapter 14: The Class Report Card

At noon, Zhang Wei, the head teacher of Class Five, Year Nine, finished his lunch and returned to his office.

"Teacher Zhang, Teacher Wang, come get the report cards." The teacher from the academic affairs office in charge of distribution walked to the office doorway, knocked, and spoke.

"Coming." Teacher Wang, who was closer to the door, stood up and took the two report cards.

Then the teacher from the academic affairs office said with a smile, "Class Six did quite well. There are two good prospects for the Fuyi High School."

"Lin Yuan and Hua Xiuxiu, right?" Teacher Wang smiled, having already anticipated this result, then added, "Class Five is definitely a bit stronger."

"Class Five is indeed slightly better," the teacher from the academic affairs office said. "This time, three students are guaranteed a spot in the Fuyi High School."

At this point, Teacher Zhang also stood up and walked over, taking the report card from Teacher Wang's hand. He too had anticipated what the teacher from the academic affairs office would say.

Three students... so it seemed there was no difference from what he had predicted.

It must be Shao Heqi, Xu Yinghuan, and Jin Yuting.

Thinking this, Zhang Wei looked down at the list.

First place should be Shao...

Shao...

Huh?

Li... Li Luo?

Huh?!

The moment Zhang Wei saw Li Luo's name, his eyes glazed over for a second. He wondered, wasn't this list supposed to be ranked by scores?

But Li Luo's student number wasn't one, either.

With this thought, Zhang Wei's gaze had already shifted to the score column.

Chinese 110... that high?

Math 112... Holy crap? Are you kidding me?

English 114... Are you sure you wrote the right name?

Science 142... Politics and History 47...

Total Score—555!

First in the class.

18th in the whole school, 86th in the whole district.

Zhang Wei looked at the report card, fell silent for a moment, and then looked further down.

Shao Heqi 554, Xu Yinghuan 520, Jin Yuting 508...

Because the admission cutoff score for the Fuyi High School in previous years was generally between 507 and 515, Jin Yuting's situation was still uncertain and rather risky.

But the first three were indeed sure bets.

Except, among these sure bets, there was someone Zhang Wei would never have expected.

"Teacher Li." Zhang Wei looked up at the teacher from the academic affairs office and couldn't help but ask, "Are you sure there's no mistake with our class's Li Luo's score?"

"Hmm? What's wrong with Li Luo?" Teacher Wang next to him leaned over with a curious look, glanced at the report card in Zhang Wei's hand, and immediately saw Li Luo's score. "Holy crap! 555? 110 in Chinese? For real?"

Teacher Wang was the Chinese teacher for both Class Five and Class Six. Seeing this Chinese score, he was completely stunned.

You had to know, in his classes, aside from the Chinese class representative Hua Xiuxiu who scored 111 on the high school entrance exam, not a single other student had passed the 110-point threshold.

And in his memory, that kid Li Luo's Chinese score had never even reached 90!

"Oh, Li Luo, right." The teacher from the academic affairs office clearly knew of this student as well. He couldn't help but shake his head and laugh. "This Li Luo from your class, he's truly impressive. His score improved by a full 130 points from the third mock exam, right?"

"About this, the school has already double-checked. The score is what it is."

"Moreover..."

"Moreover?" Zhang Wei blinked, asking with curiosity.

"Moreover, his Chinese essay got a perfect score of 40!" Teacher Li from the academic affairs office said this. "There's a meeting this afternoon that all head teachers must attend. We might add a spot for an outstanding graduate on short notice."

...

On the other side, after finishing lunch and leaving the breakfast shop, Ying Chanxi asked, "We have to wear school uniforms for the graduation ceremony, right? Should we go home and change first?"

"Yeah, let's go," Li Luo nodded in agreement.

Zhao Rongjun had already come wearing his school uniform, so he followed Li Luo to his house.

After Li Luo had changed into his uniform, Ying Chanxi came out from the opposite side, also carrying a school bag.

"Why are you carrying a school bag?" Li Luo asked curiously.

"I brought this." Ying Chanxi pulled a camera out of her bag and shook it a couple of times. "This might be the last time we go to school. I want to take some pictures to remember it. Let's take a lot of group photos later, okay?"

Looking at the camera in Ying Chanxi's hand, Li Luo fell into a rare silence.

He thought back to his past life, when he had a falling out with Ying Chanxi the day before the high school entrance exam.

Later, at the graduation ceremony, he did see Ying Chanxi with a camera, taking pictures around the school as mementos.

At that time, although their relationship had already entered a strained phase, they both still harbored some desire to ease the tension and make amends.

But Li Luo was very concerned about his pride back then and would never take any actual initiative.

And Ying Chanxi, in order to find a legitimate reason to take a group photo with Li Luo and ease their relationship, held her camera and went to every single classmate in their class to take a picture with them.

But at that time, when Li Luo saw this scene, what he thought was that since Ying Chanxi had taken a photo with everyone, he probably wasn't that special in her heart.

The so-called childhood friends were just normal, ordinary friends.

So in the end, Li Luo directly rejected her invitation for a group photo.

Thinking about it now, Li Luo really wanted to give himself a couple of good slaps.

"Let's go to school early then," Li Luo said. "The graduation ceremony is at three in the afternoon. If we go early, we can take more pictures."

The three of them set off for the school.

Yucai Middle School was just two blocks away from home, and they arrived at the school gate after a few minutes' walk.

The three of them, wearing their school uniforms, walked straight in. They didn't rush to the classroom to check in but first started wandering around the campus.

"The road by the old school gate seems to be almost repaired," Li Luo couldn't help but say after entering through the new school gate. "The new dormitory building over there is also finished, and the damn basketball court is going to be renovated during the summer break."

He didn't know why, but every time school was in session, various facilities would start getting renovated or expanded.

But often, these good things would only be officially put to use by the time you graduated.

Li Luo vaguely remembered that when they were in junior high, starting from year one, the school had begun building new teaching buildings across the river.

But it wasn't completed until the second half of their ninth-grade year.

Then, to ensure that the ninth graders' daily learning environment wouldn't change too much and affect their performance in the high school entrance exam...

Only the first and second-year students moved to the new teaching buildings, while the ninth graders stayed in the old ones for their final semester.

Now the new dormitory building was also completed and would be officially put into use next semester.

It was said that not only had the rooms gone from eight-person to six-person dorms, but they also had air conditioning installed, and the bathrooms were bigger.

But it had nothing to do with this batch of graduates anymore.

"I heard the old teaching buildings are also going to be renovated later," Ying Chanxi said, holding her camera and starting to look for a good spot. "I feel like the old school had more character. After the renovations, even though it looks new, it also feels a bit unfamiliar."

Li Luo nodded. "So it's perfect, let's take some photos to preserve it."

On the side, after turning to look at Li Luo and Ying Chanxi, Zhao Rongjun blinked, thought for a moment, and then said, "Why don't you two go take pictures? I'll go to the classroom first, see if Teacher Zhang needs any help with anything."

"Where do you think you're escaping to?" Li Luo pressed down on his shoulder. "How are the two of us supposed to take a group photo?"

Zhao Rongjun, who had been trying to slip away, was forced to stay and obediently became a qualified cameraman.

However, it wasn't just Li Luo and Ying Chanxi taking photos together. They were all classmates, so of course, they all had to take pictures together as keepsakes.

It's just that compared to the photos of Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun with their arms around each other's shoulders, and the ones where Ying Chanxi was close to Li Luo, their uniform sleeves touching, with Ying Chanxi's head tilted slightly towards Li Luo...

The group photo of Zhao Rongjun and Ying Chanxi was much more formal.

You could fit at least half a person between the two of them. Zhao Rongjun's face was tense with nervousness, and even when he made a peace sign, it was timid.

"Do you still remember that time you climbed down there?" Ying Chanxi stood by the railing beside the small stream and pointed downwards.

Li Luo nodded. Of course, he remembered.

A small stream flowed through the middle of the school, but for student safety, it was enclosed by high railings.

Only at the two bridges in the middle were the railings slightly lower. If you really wanted to, you could climb over them.

Back then, Ying Chanxi's school uniform jacket had accidentally fallen off the side of the bridge, and Li Luo had climbed in to get it. He was discovered by a teacher and was even publicly criticized in a school-wide announcement.

But he did manage to retrieve the uniform jacket.

"Hey, what are you guys doing here?"

Just as they were standing by the bridge taking pictures, their head teacher, Zhang Wei, happened to be passing by after his meeting.

Seeing Ying Chanxi and the others from a distance, he walked over and asked curiously.

"Teacher Zhang." Ying Chanxi lowered her camera, greeted her head teacher, and then said, "We're taking pictures. Teacher, would you like to join us for a group photo?"

"Sure," Zhang Wei smiled, then his gaze fell on Li Luo, and his steps immediately halted. "Well, Li Luo is here too."

With that, Zhang Wei quickly walked forward, laughed heartily, and slapped a hand on Li Luo's shoulder. "You kid, you were really amazing this time. A lot of teachers in the office were just talking about you."

"Hello, Teacher Zhang," Li Luo chuckled, then asked cheekily, "What did they say about me? I love hearing this stuff."

Truth be told, although being a head teacher meant that he usually had the biggest headaches dealing with the mischievous students in the class...

When it came to which students the teachers remembered most vividly after graduation, it was definitely this bunch of troublemakers.

After all, good students who studied well were often good in the same ways, while the misbehaving underachievers each had their own peculiar stories.

Although Li Luo wasn't that outrageous, he had done quite a few things over his three years of junior high that gave Zhang Wei a headache.

Now that Li Luo had achieved success overnight, soaring from a level where he could barely touch the cutoff for an ordinary high school to scoring dozens of points above the line for the Fuyi High School, it was truly a massive surprise for Zhang Wei.

"You rascal, you really gave a few of us teachers a shock." Zhang Wei shook his head and laughed. "When I saw the report card, I thought I was seeing things. How on earth did you manage to score 112 in math?"

Zhang Wei was a math teacher, so he naturally understood this subject best.

He really found it a bit hard to understand how Li Luo, who normally only scored in the seventies or eighties, had managed to improve to this level in just over a month.

You had to know, about a month and a half before the high school entrance exam, they had just taken a third mock exam, and Li Luo's math score was only 82.

How much time had passed since then?

His math score on the entrance exam had improved by a full 30 points!

"For this, of course, I have to thank our dear Zhao Rongjun," Li Luo said shamelessly, pulling Zhao Rongjun over and patting his shoulder forcefully, saying with a grin, "It's all because he's a good teacher."

"What about the other subjects? Chinese, Math, English, and Science, you improved by thirty or forty points in almost every single one!"

"Is that even a question?" Li Luo didn't hesitate, patting Zhao Rongjun's shoulder forcefully a few more times, making the corner of Zhao Rongjun's mouth twitch.

Zhang Wei looked at Zhao Rongjun with a stunned expression, looking him up and down, left and right, and finally couldn't help but say, "I never would have guessed. How about I give the 'Outstanding Teacher' award to you instead?"

"No, no, no, Teacher Zhang, don't joke around," Zhao Rongjun waved his hands repeatedly, looking helpless. "It's mainly because Li Luo himself got serious about studying. It doesn't have much to do with me."

"Alright, let's take the picture first," Ying Chanxi interjected at the right moment. "Teacher Zhang must still have things to do. Let's hurry up and finish."

The three of them pulled Zhang Wei over and took a few group photos by the bridge, with the teaching building in the background.

Afterward, Zhang Wei started walking towards the classroom. Before leaving, he didn't forget to turn back and say to Li Luo with a smile, "Listen carefully during the graduation ceremony later. Don't get distracted. There's a surprise for you."
